basis: Defining choroidal atrophy with visual impairment, hypotrichosis and nail dysplasia.
Hypotrichosis affects eyelid hair; hair and eyelids fall within dermatologic and ocular axes.
Mature B-cell lymphoma arising in the small intestine; lymphoma warrants the immune mechanism axis.
Focal epilepsy syndrome; no common direct damage outside the nervous system established.
Meningioma originates in the meninges.
Carcinoma originates in the colon or rectum.
Umbrella epilepsy syndrome defined by onset during infancy; no shared extracerebral organ damage.
Cerebellar degeneration with tremor, ataxia and other neurologic manifestations; abnormal eye movements do not establish ocular damage.
Lethal skeletal dysplasia; pulmonary hypoplasia occurs in 30-79%. Specific damaging ocular findings and hearing impairment are each under 30%.
IFNGR2-related primary immunodeficiency; susceptibility to infections does not establish common damage to a particular organ.
Combined cranial nerve hyperactivity disorder; cranial neuralgia and neuropathy establish nervous system involvement.
Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy with myocardial polyglucosan accumulation; no systemic metabolic disorder or extracardiac damage established.
Benign urothelial neoplasm originating in the urinary bladder.
Central lymphatic vascular malformation; chylothorax in 6/6 and respiratory distress in 4/7 support pleural/pulmonary involvement; ascites alone is not GI damage.
Dysraphic lipoma infiltrates the filum terminale with abnormal conus morphology; associated vertebral or anorectal defects lack qualifying frequency.
EXT2-related multiple osteochondromas affect bone; nerve compression and myelopathy are minority complications.
Defined by cerebral infarction resulting from occlusion of a brain artery.
Skeletal dysplasia; myopia and hearing impairment each occur in 30-79%. Cord compression and respiratory abnormalities are under 30%.
Isolated oocyte zona pellucida defect causes infertility with normal sex hormone levels; purely reproductive disease.
Chronic eczematous skin inflammation with an allergic, immune-mediated mechanism.
Hypomyelinating neurodegenerative disease; optic atrophy in 3/4 supports ocular involvement. Dysphagia is neurologic; hearing impairment occurs in only 1/4.
MFRP-related nanophthalmia with high hypermetropia and reduced visual acuity; manifestations are confined to the eye.
Glycosylation disorder with skeletal dysplasia and intellectual disability, each 30-79%. Hepatomegaly and soft skin alone do not establish functional damage.
Immune-mediated granulomatous arthritis and dermatitis define disease; uveitis is a major diagnostic feature, reported in 39/54 (~72%).
PRDM6-related persistent ductus arteriosus is a congenital cardiovascular malformation.
